info.name: Volkswagen OKAPI - Open Konfigurator Catalog API
info.description:
The Volkswagen OKAPI (Open Konfigurator API) provides access to Volkswagen AG product data, enabling developers to browse vehicle catalogs, configure cars iteratively, validate buildability, retrieve WLTP emissions data, get configuration images, and obtain pricing and technical order information. Supports all VW Group brands across global markets.

Contact Support:
 Name: Volkswagen OKAPI Developer Portal
